observations.text: Two-column layout: Input card (left, ~48%) and Result card (right). Result header carries a status chip (Idle / Starting / Error observed; docs name IN_QUEUE / IN_PROGRESS / COMPLETED for the API).
Playground loads pre-populated with a sample prompt AND a sample result (image + JSON + timing/cost line), so the result column is never empty on first visit.

Disclosure: only required inputs (Prompt) are visible; 'Additional Settings – More' reveals 8 optional params (steps slider+number, image size preset+W×H, seed+randomize, CFG slider, sync_mode switch, num_images slider, safety checker (locked: 'cannot be disabled on the playground'), output format, acceleration).
Every parameter has an (i) popover with the schema description; the API tab exposes the identical schema, defaults and enums.

Cost is shown before and after: pre-run 'Your request will cost $0.003 per megapixel'; post-run 'Your request took 0.76 seconds and will cost $0.003 per megapixel'; nb2/edit shows per-image + 'for $1.00 you can run this model 12 times' + resolution multipliers; Kling shows per-second with audio/voice tiers and a worked 5s example.
Result JSON is the raw API response (images[url,width,height,content_type], timings.inference, seed, has_nsfw_concepts, prompt). Preview/JSON is a toggle over the same object.
Completed result exposes chain actions Edit / Upscale / Make Video that deep-link another model page with ?fromOutput=<requestId> – output-to-input provenance is carried by request id.
Result also exposes Favorite, Link character (entity), Add to Collection, Share (?share=<id> permalink), Download.

Requests tab = per-model request history: search by request ID, status filter (All/Success/Error/Client error), Show preview toggle, compact/list/grid layouts, pagination. A 403 'exhausted balance' rejection did NOT create a history row.
Analytics tab: total requests, execution p50-p99, cold-boot rate, startup p50-p99, queue p90, recent errors, slower requests, per-phase cold start (pending/docker pull/setup).
Examples tab lists prior public requests: 'Request <uuid>. Status 200. <model>. <age>' + prompt + share link -> load that request into the playground.
No side-by-side compare inside the model playground; compare lives in the Sandbox (multi-model fan-out).
The 'Form ▾' combobox implies a JSON input mode alternative to the form; not opened (click did not register).
Behaviour of the status chip during a real IN_QUEUE/IN_PROGRESS run (queue position, logs) – not observable with $0 balance.
